newsitem.title: USA: Middlesex Cty noteholders consider court-paper.
newsitem.headline: Middlesex Cty noteholders consider court-paper.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group Inc's Fleet bank and The Boston Co, which hold the $4.5 million of the $4.7 million defaulted revenue anticipation notes (RANs) issued by Massachusetts' Middlesex County are considering filing suit to be paid for the notes that defaulted on Friday, according to a report in Tuesday's Boston Globe.

Meanwhile, the newspaper reported that Marriott Management Services Corp, one of the county-run hospital's creditors sued to recover $400,000 it is owed for providing food service to the medical institution.
Spokesmen for Fleet and Boston Co could not be reached immediately for comment. Middlesex County officials have not returned repeated phone calls seeking comment.

Middlesex County, the Commonwealth's largest county, which runs from Cambridge to Lowell and is home to Harvard University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, defaulted on Friday on $4.7 million of RANs after the state declined to allow the fiscally troubled county to borrow more funds. ((--Boston bureau, 617-367-4106))
